input.objective:
SwarmStream: an ownerless Solidity wrapper over the CANONICAL deployed Sablier Flow v3.0 that ties a payment stream to agreed terms (optionally an IMD job id) and settles a dispute with ONE IdentityMD oracle question (0.5 IMD), paid only by the party that disputes. The happy path costs no IMD. Foundry, Solidity 0.8.26.

DO NOT FORK SABLIER. SablierFlow.sol is BUSL-1.1: no Sablier contract source in src/. Use the GPL interfaces (ISablierFlow, Flow types, UD21x18 from @prb/math) against the deployed SablierFlow: Ethereum 0x844344cd871b28221d725ece9630e8bde4e3a181, Robinhood Chain 4663 0x6A99492B94765842808e332143296c8ADE09a922, Sepolia 0xbd9326f6366c95e39bd8ef825c1b2f2ee0dceaa1. The wrapper is the stream's SENDER (only it can pause/restart/adjust/refund); the recipient owns the stream NFT and withdraws directly on Flow, never through the wrapper.

ORACLE (follow the oracle-consumer reference exactly). Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82 on every chain; action id "oracle.request@oracle-1"; price 5e17 IMD; IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 (Ethereum), 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 (Robinhood), 0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a (Sepolia): constructor args, never hard-coded. IIntake.requestWithFailure(bytes32 action, bytes body, (address target, bytes4 selector) callback, bytes4 onFailure, address asset, uint256 amount) returns bytes32 requestId; body = compact UTF-8 JSON of the oracle request; the writer calls the callback once with 200,000 gas inside a try. Attestation: EIP-712 domain {"IdentityMD Oracle", "2", block.chainid, this}, type OracleAttestation(bytes32 requestId,uint256 chainId,bytes32 questionHash,uint8 answerType,bytes answer,uint256 figure,uint64 fromBlock,uint64 toBlock,bytes32 blockHash,bytes32 panelJobId,uint16 panelSize,uint16 quorum,uint16 agreed,uint64 issuedAt,uint64 expiresAt), struct hash uses keccak256(answer); answerType bool = 0, answer = abi.encode(bool). Signer = immutable constructor arg (today 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982).

CONTRACT src/SwarmStream.sol. Constructor, flat: (ISablierFlow flow, IIntake intake, IERC20 imd, address oracleSigner, uint40 disputeTimeout); all immutable. No owner, admin, setter, pause switch, fee, upgrade path or ETH handling; tokens are held only transiently within one call. struct Job { address client; address recipient; IERC20 token; uint128 ratePerSecond; bytes32 termsHash; string termsURI; bytes32 imdJobId; uint8 state; bytes32 requestId; uint40 disputedAt; address disputer; uint8 ruling }; enum State { None, Active, Disputed, Ruled, Closed }.
- createJobStream(address recipient, IERC20 token, uint128 ratePerSecond, uint128 amount, bytes32 termsHash, string calldata termsURI, bytes32 imdJobId) returns (uint256 streamId): pull amount (SafeERC20), approve Flow, flow.createAndDeposit(address(this), recipient, ud21x18(ratePerSecond), uint40(block.timestamp), token, false, amount); client = msg.sender; state Active. Revert on recipient zero or == msg.sender, rate 0, amount 0, termsHash 0.
- Client only, state Active: deposit(streamId, amount) (also allowed in Disputed); pause; restart(streamId, ratePerSecond) (stores the rate); adjustRate(streamId, ratePerSecond); refund(streamId, amount) and refundMax(streamId): Flow refunds to the sender = this contract, forward exactly what arrived to the client in the same call; voidAndRefund(streamId): void, refundMax to client, state Closed.
- dispute(streamId, string calldata note): client or recipient; state Active; note <= 280 bytes. Pull 0.5 IMD from msg.sender; pause if the rate is nonzero; approve the Intake for exactly 0.5 IMD; build the body on-chain (Strings, JSON-escape the note) and call requestWithFailure with callback (this, onOracleResult.selector) and onFailure.selector; store requestId, disputedAt, disputer, keccak256(Q) as questionHash; state Disputed. Body, compact: {"v":1,"question":Q,"chainId":<chainid>,"window":{"hours":24},"answerType":"bool","panelSize":5,"quorum":4,"validForSeconds":604800,"evidence":"panel","consumer":{"chainId":<chainid>,"verifyingContract":"<this, lowercase hex>"}}. Q, one fixed template: "SwarmStream stream <streamId> at <this> on chain <chainId>. Client <client> streams <token> to recipient <recipient> under the terms at <termsURI> (keccak256 <termsHash>)[, IMD job <imdJobId> if nonzero]. Dispute raised by the <client|recipient> with note: <note>. As of block <block.number>, has the recipient delivered the work those terms describe to the standard a reasonable client would accept? Answer true if yes, false if no."
- onOracleResult(bytes32 requestId, Attestation calldata a, bytes calldata signature): only the Intake; requestId must map to a Disputed stream; verify as the reference (SignatureChecker against oracleSigner); require a.requestId == requestId, a.chainId == block.chainid, a.answerType == 0, a.agreed >= a.quorum, a.quorum >= 4, block.timestamp <= a.expiresAt; ruling = decoded bool ? 1 : 2; state Ruled; emit. NEVER call Flow inside the callback (gas budget).
- submitAttestation(uint256 streamId, Attestation calldata a, bytes calldata signature): permissionless path for the same attestation if the callback did not land; identical checks plus a.requestId == Job.requestId; same effect.
- onFailure(bytes32 requestId, uint8 status, bytes32 reason, uint16 agreed, uint16 answered, bytes calldata signature): only the Intake; the stream returns to Active (still paused); either party may dispute again, paying again.
- enforce(streamId), permissionless, state Ruled: 1 -> flow.restart at the stored rate, Active; 2 -> flow.void then refundMax forwarded to the client, Closed (the recipient keeps the debt covered before the pause).
- expireDispute(streamId), permissionless: Disputed and block.timestamp > disputedAt + disputeTimeout -> Active (paused). An oracle that never answers can never lock funds.
- Views: jobOf(streamId), streamOfRequest(requestId), questionOf(streamId), expectedBody(streamId, note) so tests and a frontend reproduce the body byte for byte.
Rules: an event for every transition; custom errors for every revert; SafeERC20; checks-effects-interactions plus nonReentrant on every function that moves tokens; fee-on-transfer and rebasing stream tokens are unsupported and documented, not handled; chain id is read only from block.chainid.

steps.objective:
BUILD CONFIG. Root foundry.toml under [profile.default]: solc 0.8.26, optimizer true, optimizer_runs 200, evm_version cancun, via_ir false, bytecode_hash = "none"; README quotes foundry.toml verbatim. Dependencies as git submodules or soldeer: @sablier/flow (interfaces and types only are imported), @prb/math, @openzeppelin/contracts (SafeERC20, EIP712, SignatureChecker, Strings, ReentrancyGuard). script/Deploy.s.sol reads FLOW, INTAKE, IMD, ORACLE_SIGNER, DISPUTE_TIMEOUT from env, refuses zero addresses, and logs the deployed address.

OPEN SOURCE. SPDX MIT on every file. README states: not audited; the swarm's adversarial review is not an audit; the oracle is a panel judgement bought from IdentityMD, not a court; what each party can do in each state; the disputer's 0.5 IMD is spent whether or not the panel agrees; link the IdentityMD oracle docs and the Sablier Flow docs; credit Sablier and say Flow itself is not included. No investment, yield or return language.
acceptanceCriteria: No Sablier contract source in src/; Flow is reached only through its interfaces at the given deployed addresses, and the wrapper is the stream's sender
Flat 5-argument constructor; every field immutable; no owner, setter, pause switch, fee or upgrade path
dispute pulls exactly 0.5 IMD from the caller, pauses the stream and calls IIntake.requestWithFailure with the specified compact JSON body and callbacks

onOracleResult and submitAttestation verify the IdentityMD EIP-712 attestation (domain version 2, the given type string, keccak256 of answer) against the immutable signer, accept only agreed >= quorum, unexpired, bool answers for a Disputed stream, once, and never call Flow
enforce applies the ruling: accepted restarts at the stored rate; rejected voids and forwards refundMax to the client; expireDispute frees a stream after disputeTimeout
foundry.toml sets bytecode_hash = "none" with the pinned solc, optimizer, evm_version and via_ir; README quotes it, states the project is not audited and uses no yield or return language

steps.objective: TESTS test/: deploy SablierFlow locally from the @sablier/flow package inside tests only (never in src/), or run against a Sepolia fork when SEPOLIA_RPC is set; a MockIntake that pulls the 0.5 IMD, returns a deterministic requestId and records the body; a test signer key whose address is passed as oracleSigner, with attestations built with vm.sign over the exact EIP-712 hash. Cover: create and stream accrual; every client function in every state (allowed and refused); recipient withdraws directly on Flow during Active, Disputed and after enforce; dispute by each party and by a stranger (refused); the body bytes equal expectedBody; onOracleResult from a stranger, for an unknown requestId, twice, with a wrong signer, wrong chainId, wrong answerType, agreed < quorum, expired (all refused); accepted ruling -> enforce restarts at the stored rate; rejected ruling -> enforce voids and the client receives exactly refundableAmountOf while the recipient still withdraws covered debt; submitAttestation after a missed callback; onFailure returns to Active and a second dispute works; expireDispute before and after the timeout; reentrancy through a malicious ERC-20 and a malicious recipient; fuzz rates/amounts/time; gas report proving onOracleResult < 150,000 gas.
